commands.name: issue
commands.description: Read and write Jira issues

commands.name: list
commands.description: List issues matching a query or filters

options.name: --query
options.description: Name of a saved query to run (see 'jira query'); ANDed with any other filters

options.name: --jql
options.description: A raw JQL query; ANDed with any other filters

options.name: --project
options.description: Only issues in this project (key or name)

options.name: --label
options.description: Only issues with this label; repeat the option to require several

options.name: --assigned
options.description: Only issues assigned to you [default: False]

options.name: --reported
options.description: Only issues reported (created) by you [default: False]

options.name: --include-done
options.description: Include done issues too (by default only issues that are not done are listed) [default: False]

options.name: --parent
options.description: Only issues in the hierarchy below this issue (key); repeat to union several. Not combinable with other filters

options.name: --priority
options.description: Only issues with this priority (e.g. High)

options.name: --count
options.description: Maximum number of issues to fetch [default: 100]

options.name: --json
options.description: Print machine-readable JSON instead of the human-readable report [default: False]

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a Jira issue

options.name: --project
options.description: Project key the issue belongs to. Required unless --template presets one

options.name: --summary
options.description: Summary (title) of the issue

options.name: --description
options.description: Description of the issue

options.name: --type
options.description: Issue type (Task, Spike, Epic, ...) [default: Task]

options.name: --parent
options.description: Parent (epic, for a story; story, for a sub-task) issue key

options.name: --label
options.description: Label to add to the issue; repeat the option to add several

options.name: --assigned
options.description: Assign the new issue to you [default: False]

options.name: --priority
options.description: Priority (e.g. High) - not templated

options.name: --due
options.description: Due date, yyyy-MM-dd - not templated

options.name: --fix-version
options.description: Fix version to set; repeat the option to add several - not templated

options.name: --field
options.description: Set another field by display name: --field "Story Points"=5 (see 'jira field list'); repeat for several. A --template's own fields still apply for any name not given here

options.name: --template
options.description: Name of a saved template (see 'jira template') to preset --project/--type/--parent/--label/--description from; any of those given explicitly here override the template's value
